final: WITH c AS (SELECT u.acctscope AS scope, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS n FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = r.ordervault JOIN users u ON u.userstamp = o.userlink GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT scope, n AS order_count, n * 1.0 / SUM(n) OVER () AS share_of_total, n * 1.0 / AVG(n) OVER () AS ratio_to_avg FROM c
